description: This file is a shell script that contains automated tests for Git's handling of the --alternate-refs feature. It sets up repositories, makes commits, and verifies the behavior of Git commands related to alternate references.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the commands inside the block, and validates expectations.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the timestamp used in commits to ensure unique commit times.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files.
